name: io.github.borgels/mcp-server-personio
title: Personio
description: MCP server for the Personio HR API with employee and HR-admin profiles.

environmentVariables.name: PERSONIO_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Personio API client id (Settings, Integrations, API credentials).

environmentVariables.name: PERSONIO_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Tool profile: employee (self-service, needs PERSONIO_DEFAULT_USER) or hr (company-wide).

environmentVariables.name: PERSONIO_DEFAULT_USER
environmentVariables.description: Required for the employee profile (the default): your Personio email, which the self-service tools act as.

environmentVariables.name: PERSONIO_HR_LEGAL_ENTITY
environmentVariables.description: HR profile only: legal entity id this instance is confined to.

environmentVariables.name: PERSONIO_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Path of the JSONL audit log.
